request: 出牌燃烧、手牌化灰、按卡配置命中特效、自身目标蓝色渐变提示。所有效果使用生成透明位图。

assets.purpose: 出牌魂火燃烧透明位图
assets.prompt: Use case: game-vfx sprite. Create ONE isolated transparent bitmap visual effect for a hand-painted Chinese underworld deckbuilding game. Subject: a beautiful vertical wave of turquoise-blue ghost fire engulfing the edges of a tall invisible playing card as it burns away. The implied card silhouette is tall portrait approximately 4:7, but DO NOT draw the card itself, any paper rectangle, any symbol, any text, any numbers, any character, or UI frame. Draw blue cyan flame tongues licking upwards along both sides and curling across the bottom, with a few warm gold ember flecks, dark teal ink edge accents and subtle watercolor pigment texture. Center mostly transparent so a real game card beneath remains visible. Not realistic 3D fire, not neon sci-fi, no heavy smoke. Effect occupies about 75 percent of a square canvas; all tips fully inside image with generous clear margin. No ground, no scenery, no cast shadow, no opaque square, no checkerboard. True alpha transparency outside AND through the center. Clean silhouette, bright enough to read over a pastel teal environment, painterly gouache, crisp decorative flame shapes. Output one square transparent PNG, a single usable VFX sprite, not a spritesheet.

assets.purpose: 回合末手牌灰烬透明位图
assets.prompt: Use case: game-vfx sprite. Create ONE isolated transparent bitmap visual effect of a discarded paper talisman becoming ash for a hand-painted Chinese underworld card game. A compact rising cloud of scattered ivory and charcoal-gray papery ash flakes with a few tiny warm amber embers, curling pale gray watercolor wisps. Fragments are irregular angular bits of burned parchment with hand ink contour detail, densely gathered at the lower center then gently dispersing upwards and outward, an elegant readable gesture. No complete card or large rectangle, no letters or numbers, no characters, no icons, no scenery or ground. 2D storybook gouache and ink, deliberately stylized, clear alpha gaps between every flake, not realistic photograph or 3D smoke. Square transparent canvas, effect fills central 75 percent with all fragments and wisps inside margin. Some midtone slate ash stays readable against pale blue ground. Real alpha transparency, no white or black background, no checkerboard, no opaque blur panel. One sprite, not a spritesheet.

assets.purpose: 自身目标底部蓝色渐变引导透明位图
assets.prompt: Use case: game-vfx overlay sprite. Create one wide transparent BLUE SELF-TARGET GUIDANCE overlay for the bottom edge of a portrait mobile Chinese underworld card game. Composition: a shallow, graceful crescent of luminous blue-cyan mist across the lower edge, gathering at the bottom center and gradually fading upward into true transparency. Small restrained hand-painted ghost-flame curls at the two lower corners, a very subtle low arc of watercolor soul-light connecting them. The upper TWO THIRDS are almost entirely transparent; lower third contains a blue translucent atmospheric watercolor wash, brighter center close to bottom. It must feel like gentle invitation to drag a defensive card downward to the player's feet, not a UI panel. No arrow, no icons, no text, no numbers, no frame, no solid rectangle, no big flame, no character or objects. 2D Chinese storybook watercolor/gouache with softly irregular organic edges, cyan and muted royal blue color, not neon sci-fi. Wide landscape 3:1 canvas with all side curls inside 6 percent side margins. Real semitransparent alpha fading from low edge to nothing above, no checkerboard, no white/black background. A single usable overlay bitmap, not a full game screenshot.
